bingx.notes: Web frontend endpoints work without auth. REST API requires BINGX_API_KEY + BINGX_SECRET_KEY with HMAC-SHA256. Platform has 400K+ elite traders and 11.5M+ copy trading users.

gate.notes: Gate.io copy trading API not in official v4 docs. Web frontend endpoints reverse-engineered from gate.com Next.js app. 171K+ total copiers, $5.97M+ copier returns. Gate.io redirects from gate.io to gate.com.

mexc.notes: MEXC copy trading API not publicly documented. Futures API limited to institutional users. 21K+ verified traders, 2M+ copy trading users. Copy trading futures-only (no spot). Profit share 5-35%. Also runs AI-Masters competitions with LLM trading bots.
